Monologue: My…this place makes me wish those idiots were still in power. Goodness. Look at the walls, look at the plates. Oh, don't make that face.
I am Nadezdha, the honorable right hand of Svetka. Take care to remember me.
I've been sent to threaten you. I'm famous for beheading the king, you see, so Svetka throws me this way and that. Can you keep a secret?
My mother didn't— Well, I don't much care whether or not my mother deserved to die. I just didn't want her to.
So, when the king next distributed food, I poisoned it, blamed it on the him, and we rebels had his head. No one else involved.
I still remember the burn my arms felt while beheading that rat. Good times.
If you want to lay your head on the chopping block next, then be my guest.
